title: Corpus of Hate Speech from Ten Datasets: Historical MSc Corpus and Audited Research Workflow
description:
Complete historical MSc research corpus integrating ten existing hate-speech and related subjective-language datasets, developed by Monika Wiczewa at the University of Sheffield. The archive includes original source datasets, cleaned and tokenized text, notebooks, historical experiment files, and a separate audited 2026 group-aware splitting and verification workflow.

The audited workflow processes 257,576 usable cleaned records, assigns normalized-identical sentence groups to the same split, and oversamples training only. These are data-integrity results, not new model-performance results. Source attribution and licence evidence are recorded in SOURCES.md and BIBLIOGRAPHY.md; no uniform licence for all third-party upstream text is asserted.
notes: Full repository snapshot, including upstream dataset copies and historical artifacts. Consult SOURCES.md for source-specific attribution and unresolved licence details. No blanket licence is claimed for third-party material.
